headline: Mahindra and Mahindra Discloses Substantial Acquisition Under SEBI Takeover Regulations
sum: Mahindra and Mahindra Limited filed a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011 regarding a substantial acquisition of shares in Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited. The acquisition details, valuation and structure require review of the full disclosure document.
detail: Mahindra and Mahindra Limited submitted a formal disclosure to NSE under Regulation 31(4) of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011. The disclosure pertains to a substantial acquisition in Mahindra Lifespace Developers Limited, a listed real-estate and infrastructure development company. The filing triggers the acquirer's obligations to comply with mandatory open offer requirements and ongoing disclosures under the Takeover Regulations. Specific consideration, shareholding percentage, conditions precedent and timelines require access to the full disclosure document.
